amount: Most grants CAD 2,000–8,000; no fixed minimum/maximum
eligible: Yes for registered Canadian charities and other listed Canadian entities
reason: Accessible Canadian environmental funder with a clear deadline. Best fit is water education, citizen science, shoreline/habitat or community stewardship rather than infrastructure or academic research.
next_action: Frame the water project around community engagement, citizen science or habitat stewardship and keep the request proportionate to typical awards.
